instruction: Change the slide background to green color and add the title text to notes.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires applying a green background (RGB [0, 128, 0]) to the slide and adding the title text 'Should You Consider Studying Abroad?' to the notes section. The evaluator checks both the background color (with 10-point tolerance) and the notes text, giving partial credit (0.5 each).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct background color (green with tolerance), 0.5 for correct notes text
